summary: Resolve whether this empty issue represents a product requirement, a decision log, or obsolete backlog before implementation.
decisions: Do not infer implementation scope from an empty issue body.
Either add explicit purpose and acceptance criteria or close the issue as obsolete.

in: Add acceptance criteria or close recommendation
out: Product code changes based on guessed meaning

blockers: The issue body has no actionable requirement or completion condition.

risks.description: Implementation would encode an assumption not made by the product owner.
risks.mitigation: Keep blocked until the issue is completed or explicitly closed.

gates.description: State what Point means, its user value, and done condition, or approve closure.

acceptanceCriteria: The issue has an explicit product outcome and testable completion criteria, or is closed as obsolete.
Any resulting scope is linked to the correct source document and implementation wave.

rollback.strategy: Reopen the decision if new source material contradicts it; no product rollback is needed before code exists.
rollback.verification: The manifest and issue body again agree on state and purpose.
